phases.name: Write the regression fixture and prove it fails against the unfixed script
Apply the regex fix and reconcile the stale pattern references

constraints: Edit agent-system/extensions/** only; never write under .claude/**. The lean extension is not loaded in this deploy, so no redeploy step is required or appropriate.
strip_lean_comments()'s executable body must remain byte-identical; only its docstring text changes.
Keep the per-line accumulator 'if sorry_re.search(line): total += 1' byte-identical -- do not switch to findall/occurrence counting.
Do not implement a line-level warn.sorry skip filter; it drops real same-line sorries.
The new test file is outside specs/**, so it must carry no task-number citations.
Phase 1's fixture MUST be run against the unfixed script and MUST fail before Phase 2 begins (falsifiability gate).
verification_bar: Fixture suite exits 1 pre-fix and 0 post-fix; real-corpus differential shows delta == independently-grepped own-line 'set_option warn.sorry false in' count with the post-fix inventory a strict subset of pre-fix; 'cross_check: MATCH' observed via --cross-check on ~/Projects/cslib (Cslib/Logics/Bimodal) or its non-completion recorded as a reasoned exclusion with evidence. Verify by execution, never by inspection.
